profile.name: Mohammad Mahdi Mohebbi
profile.bio: Product Designer with 5+ years of experience turning complex systems into intuitive, scalable digital products. I don’t just bridge design and strategy. I craft high-impact user experiences from the first concept to the final pixel.

sections.title: These are ones that taught me the most
Where i'm good and where i learned from

items.title: Product Designer
items.highlight: Designing core financial products, including the SnappPay Wallet.
items.body: I focus on scalable, user-centric experiences for fintech services, from customer-facing flows such as Cashback, Gift Card, Gold purchase, and withdrawals to back-office dashboards. I work with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering, and keep the work aligned with the design system.

items.title: Product Designer
items.highlight: Led design of the Setareh-Yek loan platform, which has distributed over 500 billion toman in loans.
items.body: I designed the loan acquisition and management experience for users, vendors, and administrators, including the application flow, installment tools, dashboards, campaign pages, and credit-scoring checks.

items.title: UX/UI Designer
items.highlight: Contributed to the Morph Design System, now past 7,800 Figma community duplicates.
items.body: I worked on SetareYek, SetareSim, and Rondtarin with five designers. I migrated 10+ services from Adobe XD to Figma, redesigned a responsive B2B dashboard used by Asanpardakht, HamrahCard, and Parsian, and designed the SetareSim e-commerce platform.

items.title: Product Design Mentor
items.highlight: Mentoring students in the Product Design Bootcamp.
items.body: I guide students on UX research, UI design, design systems, and AR/VR design through feedback sessions, real-world product challenges, and reviews of the projects they build during the course.

items.title: Product Design Instructor
items.highlight: Teaching the Product Design course at Cando.
items.body: I teach product design fundamentals, UX research, benchmarking, UI design, Figma, and portfolio development, and I lead workshops on resume writing and building a professional social-media presence.

items.summary: A flawless design can still fail to ship, because the real obstacles in product work are usually human, not technical. Craft gets a designer into the room, but soft skills decide what happens next
